project.name: ImpactFlow
project.problem: Public-benefit projects need funding that supporters can follow and review.
project.approach: Combine organization onboarding, NEAR wallet flows, NEAR Intents routing and milestone-oriented escrow with optional post-goal staking.

capabilities.evidence: Local API supports accounts, organization profiles and project submissions.
limitations: Profiles are not verified.
Storage is local JSON, not production infrastructure.

capabilities.evidence: HOT Labs NEAR Connect is configured for NEAR Testnet wallet selection and transaction signing.
limitations: A wallet connection is not proof that the escrow contract is deployed.

capabilities.evidence: The API retrieves supported assets from NEAR Intents and forwards dry quote previews.
limitations: A dry preview does not create a deposit address or move funds.

capabilities.evidence: The app can request a non-dry 1Click quote after the preview and display returned deposit instructions.
limitations: The user must send funds from their own wallet.
Live route completion has not been verified here.

capabilities.evidence: The app contains NEP-413 sign-in and sends the selected confidentiality mode with eligible quote requests.
limitations: Wallet authentication must succeed against the live service.
Named NEAR accounts may need to register the signing public key on intents.near before authentication.
Confidential routing does not guarantee anonymity.

capabilities.evidence: NEAR Testnet account impactflow-escrow-xyz.testnet runs code hash 5v9deX8YbbDr2q2PaP4Jp8Rq9ssc7tUq3nohHGJwHfzT, which matches a release build of contract/src/lib.rs. On-chain history shows successful create_campaign, approve_campaign, donate (including from a separate user account), propose_milestone, submit_milestone_evidence and approve_and_release transactions, plus the v2 upgrade (migrate_v2) and the v3 upgrade adding per-campaign hold dates (migrate_v3, 13 November 2026). Donations close at a campaign's hold date; staking is only allowed while at least three days remain, and anyone can force the unstake in that final window.
limitations: Milestone evidence is a submitted link; the contract does not verify real-world impact.
The contract is on Testnet and has not been independently audited.

capabilities.evidence: The Rust contract gates owner-initiated staking on the full campaign goal, protects escrow accounting, supports unstake and delayed withdrawal, and credits pool rewards back to the same campaign. The upgraded contract and reviewer-only migration are deployed. Read-only Testnet RPC verified both pre-existing campaigns and milestones after migration; the UI exposes reviewer pool configuration and owner controls.
limitations: No Testnet staking pool has been configured, and stake, unstake and withdrawal transactions have not completed end-to-end.
One active campaign staking position is supported across this contract at a time.
Withdrawal is time-locked by the selected pool (normally at least four epochs); rewards are not guaranteed and validator or contract risk remains.
The upgrade and migrate_v2 completed on Testnet on 5 November 2026; independent contract review is still required before any real-fund use.

capabilities.evidence: The first campaign cards and visible impact ledger are labeled as sample or demo content in the app.
limitations: The displayed totals are not verified donations.

capabilities.evidence: The demo contribution flow displays a receipt in the modal.
limitations: No wallet is contacted.
No funds move.
The selected amount and display preference are not saved or sent.

capabilities.evidence: Signed-in project submitters can request structured clarity and completeness feedback from NEAR AI Cloud. The agent returns strengths, gaps, questions and possible milestones.
limitations: Requires NEAR_AI_API_KEY and NEAR_AI_MODEL configured on the server and may consume provider credits.
Does not verify facts or organization identity and cannot approve/reject proposals or release funds.
Live model response has not been verified until the operator configures credentials.

reviewWalkthrough: Open Cross-chain and wait for the live supported-asset list.
Choose source and destination assets and enter valid recipient and refund addresses.
Request a dry quote preview; no funds move in this step.
Inspect the code and README before treating any prototype status as production-ready.
In the signed-in project submission form, request an AI readiness review; inspect its explicit data-sharing notice and treat the output as advice for a human reviewer.
evaluationNote: This manifest describes the prototype for human and automated review. It contains no hidden scoring instructions; verify claims against the source and observed behavior.

implemented: HttpOnly SameSite session cookies; Secure in production
Origin allowlist for state-changing browser requests
Per-client API throttling and per-account failed-login throttling
Timing-equalized password check for unknown accounts
Security response headers and 32 KB JSON body limit
boundaries: API does not custody or transfer user funds
NEAR Intents routing and Testnet escrow are separate systems
limitations: Sessions and throttles are in-memory and reset on restart
Local JSON storage is not production-grade
No independent penetration test or contract audit
Production deployment requires persistent controls, monitoring, backups and HTTPS
